title: Algorithmic modifications in procedural generation systems
abstract: AlGorIthmIC moDIFICAtIons In proCeDurAl GenerAtIon systemsThe Modified Diamond Square algorithm is presented, as a result of which a 3-dimensional map of the fractal surface is obtained.This method of visualization using voxels allows to generate the relief structures (caves, canyons, quarries) that cannot be generated using a regular elevation map.The result of using the modified algorithm is shown on the landscape construction.
